"""Read retained successful installed-role output and current SDK profile."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
assert os.geteuid() == 0 and os.uname().nodename == 'anvil-qa-v1'
root = Path('/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1')
folder = root / 'backups/qualification-e49e149-v2'
out = {'installed': {}}
for role in ('api','worker','business-worker','golden-scheduler','golden-grader','native-coordinator','private-scoring-coordinator'):
    raw = (folder / ('installed-' + role + '.private.stdout')).read_bytes()
    body = json.loads(raw)
    assert body['source_sha256'] == 'c26a7965e3ee215aa74e495c5341c15a2e0423f3952a1799111e8eef688201e4'
    assert body['component_ready'] is (role != 'private-scoring-coordinator')
    out['installed'][role] = {'body':body,'stdout_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
program = "import json;from anvil.golden_native_peer import inspect_sdk;from anvil.praxis_generic_contract import digest;s=inspect_sdk('unix:///run/docker.sock');print(json.dumps({'profile':s,'profile_sha256':digest(s)}))"
raw = subprocess.check_output(['docker','exec','anvil-qa-v1-native-coordinator-1','/opt/anvil-runtime/bin/python','-I','-B','-c',program],timeout=60)
out['sdk'] = json.loads(raw)
receipt = json.loads((root / 'runtime-functional/harbor-proof/component-qualification/current.json').read_bytes())
out['receipt_sdk_sha256'] = receipt['mediated_sdk_profile_sha256']
assert out['sdk']['profile_sha256'] == out['receipt_sdk_sha256']
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
